entities.summary: Hiram, a notable figure in the history of Lebanon, associated with Ancient Phoenicia (1200 BCE–332 BCE). Preceded by Tyre, Sidon, and Mediterranean Expansion and Byblos becomes a major exporter of cedar and papyrus to Egypt. Their legacy influenced Phoenician alphabet develops — ancestor of virtually all modern alphabets and Phoenicians found Carthage from Tyre.
